name: Elmexabarber
eyebrow: A men's barber shop on Research Boulevard in north Austin. Walk in, or call ahead and we will hold a chair for you.
headline: Men's barbering on Research Boulevard.
subline: Cuts, fades and beard work, Monday to Friday. Card and contactless accepted.

services.title: Haircut
services.body: A consultation first, then a cut shaped to how your hair actually grows, finished so you can repeat it at home.

services.title: Skin fade
services.body: Clipper work taken down to the skin and blended properly, with no hard lines left behind.

services.title: Beard trim
services.body: Shaped and lined with a razor, hot towel, and oil worked through at the end.

services.title: Hot towel shave
services.body: The traditional straight razor shave. Hot towels, two passes, and time in the chair.

services.title: Cut and beard together
services.body: Both in one visit, which is how most regulars book it.

faq.a: Monday to Friday, 9:00 in the morning until 5:00 in the afternoon. We are closed Saturday and Sunday.
9063 Research Boulevard, Unit 102, Austin TX 78758, in north Austin just off US-183.
Call (512) 999-4411 and we will put you in the book. If you would rather just turn up, come earlier in the day when it is quieter.
Card and contactless, including tap to pay.
Yes. Bring them in earlier in the day if you can, it is calmer and the wait is shorter.
